explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/360: with f(n) the least number of classes in a partition of {1,…,n−1} such that n is not a sum of distinct elements of one class, 'Alon and Erdős [AlEr96] proved … n^{1/3}/(log n)^{4/3} ≪ f(n) ≪ n^{1/3}(log log n)^{1/3}/(log n)^{1/3}'. The Lean variant states both bounds as Big-O relations over ℕ, with f n the sInf over Finpartitions of Icc 1 (n−1) whose parts avoid n in their subset sums (nonempty via singletons for n ≥ 2). Direct transcription. Faithful.
